lessons.title: From Motion to Electricity: The Dynamo Teaser
lessons.focus: Bicycle dynamo demo: spin → bulb lights; generator is a motor backwards; bridge to CBE 3.2 next year.
lessons.advanced: Estimate: your turbine spins a dynamo at 5 V/0.3 A — efficiency chain from stream to light.

lessons.title: The Ram and the Siphon Return
lessons.focus: Review: both move water with no engine; ram needs fall, siphon needs outlet lower than inlet; pick per site.
lessons.advanced: Site: spring 3 m above field, 100 m away, stream crossing between: siphon, ram or pipe? Defend with head math.

lessons.title: Rainwater Harvesting Physics
lessons.focus: Roof catchment = rainfall × area; gutters and first-flush; tank sizing for the dry term; Kenyan rainfall patterns.
lessons.advanced: Roof 60 m², rain 800 mm/year, dry spell 90 days at 200 L/day: size the tank in m³ with reasoning.

lessons.title: Gravity Water Schemes: From Spring to Village
lessons.focus: Survey head with the Unit 7 water level; pipe sizing to limit friction; break-pressure tanks on long drops.
lessons.advanced: A 3 km pipe drops 120 m: why insert break-pressure tanks? Compute static pressure at the bottom without them.

lessons.title: Storing Energy: Two Tanks and a Pump
lessons.focus: Pumped storage idea: pump up when sunny/windy, flow down when needed; compare with batteries and flywheels.
lessons.advanced: 1000 L raised 5 m stores how many kJ? What bulb wattage for how long at 50% round-trip efficiency?

lessons.title: Community Wind & Water Survey
lessons.focus: Walk the area: note streams, slopes, windy ridges, existing pumps; interview a fundi; map resources.
lessons.advanced: Score three sites with a weighted matrix (head, flow, distance, demand); defend the weights.

lessons.title: Design Brief: Power for Our School
lessons.focus: Teams design one wind or water solution for a real school need (garden watering, handwash station); drawings and budget.
lessons.advanced: Include energy budget: demand L/day, source power curve, storage, and the worst-month shortfall plan.

lessons.title: Unit Review: Energy Projects Showcase
lessons.focus: Windmill, turbines and surveys on show; visitors try the anemometer; unit quiz.
lessons.advanced: Panel question: 'Is small wind worth it here?' — argue from your measured data, both sides.
